| `RB3_UI_POST_GRADE` | feature | off | render/postproc | live: menu grade-exempt UI compositing (Wave-13/14 UIGRADE), default-ON as of the Wave-14 coordinator E1 flip — hub focused-text contrast 1.95->2.20, song_select red-band fixed via menu-boundary depth LoadOp::Load; legacy opt-in name retired, opt out via RB3_UI_POST_GRADE_OFF (legacy =0 disable kept). not-live (default-OFF; trigger WIRED W13 G-TRIGGER): W13 Lane G (UIGRADE) grade-exempt menu UI. Menus render the whole frame (venue backdrop + UI) into the postproc intermediate and grade it ONCE at BandRnd::EndFrame, washing focused-item text (hub focused p60/p5 1.95 default vs 2.20 with grade off / RB3_PP_OFF). ON flushes the venue grade at the MENU venue->UI boundary so UI draws UNGRADED on top. G-S1 premise was WRONG: menu dirs have mCanEndWorld=1 (not 0) and already call Rnd::EndWorld(), but on native BandRnd::BeginDrawing bypasses base Rnd::BeginDrawing and never resets mWorldEnded, so EndWorld() is a PERMANENT NO-OP -> the proposed EndWorld-reuse trigger never flushes. WIRED trigger (PanelDir::DrawShowing, HX_NATIVE): when RB3UIPostGradeActive() && NOT in gameplay (TheGamePanel->GetGameState()!=kGamePlaying), set the menu-flush latch (RB3SetMenuUIFlushPending) then drive the flush via the existing public TheRnd->ClearDepthForOverlay() seam (the only game-side path to FlushPostProcMidFrame w/o an engine-header grant), which composites the venue with venueGrade=FALSE (chroma-preserve stays off, authored B+W look untouched, A5 trap) and reopens the pass so UI draws ungraded. Latch now consumed at the TOP of FlushPostProcMidFrame (bounds it per-flush; can't dangle into a gameplay flush). Gameplay gate is REQUIRED (gameplay already flushes ~1/frame via TrackPanel; firing the menu trigger there breaks pixel-invariance). VERIFIED default-OFF: hub 1.954->2.204 (>=2.0 win, ==PP_OFF target), partdiff 1.409->1.417 (in-band), A5 hub-backdrop chroma unchanged (Δ<0.6), gameplay kGamePlaying flush counts equal ON/OFF, flag-OFF drawlog 792 canonical PASS + Wii byte-identical (#ifdef HX_NATIVE). CAVEAT: song_select 1.110->1.049 (below [1.06,1.17] parity band) = ClearDepthForOverlay else-branch depth-clears (renders fully, fully legible); a clean flush-ONLY seam needs FlushPostProcMidFrame made public in ungranted Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.h -> ESCALATE followup.
